drafted_from: workflow row in tools/workflows/recipes/workflows.json (input_schema, the 11 steps with their submit shapes and the monthly-check wake); read from the row's words, no test runs it
start_here: Say to your AI: "Run workflow:put-a-households-money-in-order with my words: the electric bill is past due and I think a streaming subscription still charges me. I can use about 400 dollars now."
no_lists_because: The item names no list in its own words, input or steps, so it has no example rows to ship.
instructions: 1. Say what is on your mind about money in your own words, even vaguely ("get my money in order" is enough); add cash_available_cents (like 40000) only if you know it, and for_whom only for another household member who has a consent row.

2. Say "Run workflow:put-a-households-money-in-order". The AI starts it with tool:start-a-recipe-run and works the steps open-the-pursuit, connect-the-sources, inventory-every-item, reconcile-against-cash, research-each-item, decide-the-order, draft-every-message, file-every-movement-for-approval, act-on-approved-rows, follow-up-until-closed, repeat-monthly.
3. Read the inventory: one row per bill, debt, subscription or refund, each with the exact sentence from its source; read each researched rule with its address and quote.
4. Open the decision case for the order and approve it; every payment, cancellation and message waits as one row on your Waiting-on-you list until you approve it, and nothing moves before that.
5. Items close only on a readback (a matching line, a confirmation id or the payee's written end of balance); a monthly wake runs the whole thing again and writes one summary row.

worked_examples.title: A vague money request opens one pursuit with its areas
worked_examples.ask: Put my money in order: the electric bill is past due and a streaming service may still charge me.

input.request: The electric bill is past due and I think a streaming subscription still charges me.

worked_examples.given: Read from tools/workflows/recipes/workflows.json (step open-the-pursuit): no pursuit holds this money yet, so the step writes pursuit:money-in-order with the person's words quoted, record:calendar-task-list:money-in-order, the trunk record:calendar-task:money-in-order-trunk and one branch per default area (bills-and-due-dates, debts, owed-to-me, subscriptions, cash-and-allocation, decisions); for_whom was not given, so no consent row is needed.
